name: use_group
description: What the parcel or building is used for: current occupancy or taxation grouping (land and buildings)

name: use_group_combined
description: Combined use group and subgroup label

name: purpose_group
description: What the building was built (made) for; not applicable to unimproved land

name: purpose_group_combined
description: Combined purpose group and subgroup label

name: occupancy_type
description: Inferred occupancy: residential class (Single-Family / Multi-Family split into HAZUS Low/Mid/High-Rise bands by n_stories / Manufactured Home / Secondary) or NSI/parcel non-residential category; also the base for provenance-suffixed evidence variants attributed during harmonize (occupancy_type_building_nsi, occupancy_type_footprint_fema, ...) and curate (occupancy_type_parcel)

name: land_value_imputed
description: Estimated land value for a parcel whose land value is missing or zero despite a positive improvement value and evidence it should carry one (residential land use, or footprint area disproportionate to its use_group_combined peers); a local per-area estimate (street+city cohort, falling back to the county-scoped use_group_combined average) times the parcel's total footprint area

name: improvement_value_imputed
description: Improvement value re-derived as improvement_value minus land_value_imputed (clipped at 0), on the parcels land_value_imputed applies to

name: structure_value
description: Building's own assessed/replacement value, net of land (real apportioned improvement value where available, else the NSI-modeled replacement value); structure_value_building_nsi is the NSI-only evidence variant

name: address_conflict
description: Address evidence disagreement summary across sources (e.g. 'parcel: 789 ELM ST | dwelling_overture: 999 PINE ST'); null when the sources agree

name: postal_zip5
description: Normalized 5-digit ZIP code used for postal_city lookups

name: postal_city_acceptable
description: USPS-acceptable alternate city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: postal_city_unacceptable
description: USPS-unacceptable city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: n_dwellings
description: Number of dwelling units in the building

name: occupancy_type_base
description: Occupancy class before Multi-Family is split into height bands (pre-refinement occupancy_type)

name: occupancy_type_conflict
description: Occupancy evidence disagreement summary across all sources (e.g. 'nsi: X | fema: Y | parcel: Z'); null when the evidences agree

name: occupancy_type_review
description: Flag where improvement value is a small nonzero share of total value (possible manufactured home for review)

name: manufactured_home_community
description: Flag where the parcel is classified as a manufactured-home community/park; footprints get the same-named, richer refinement of it (a parcel with more than the threshold count of manufactured-home footprints, per the final footprint occupancy)

name: n_manufactured_homes_per_parcel
description: Number of manufactured-home footprints on the footprint's parcel

name: land_use_class
description: Parcel land-use class: rule-based classes (e.g. Manufactured Home Park, RV Park, Townhome, Condominium, Vacant) with defaults voted from group_parcel/group_building_nsi/group_footprint_fema

name: n_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of footprints on the parcel

name: n_small_elongated_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of small elongated (manufactured-home-shaped) footprints on the parcel

name: n_primary_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of non-accessory footprints on the parcel (excludes secondary/accessory structures)

name: max_footprint_area_m2
description: Largest footprint area on the parcel

name: sum_footprint_area_m2
description: Total real (non-synthetic) footprint area on the parcel

name: max_parcels_per_footprint
description: Maximum number of parcels linked to any dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel (from the real, non-FEMA footprint spine)

name: max_dwellings_per_footprint
description: Maximum confirmed dwelling-unit count (Overture) on any single dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel

name: year_first_buildup_hisdac
description: First build-up year from HISDAC FBUY raster

name: recorded_date
description: Date the deed was recorded at the registry

name: price_raw
description: Transaction price as provided by the source

name: parcel_id_all
description: All overlapping parcel identifiers (pipe-joined; dominant parcel first by descending intersection area; missing when identical to parcel_id)

name: parcel_id_admin2
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-2 unit

name: parcel_id_admin3
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-3 unit

name: parcel_id_admin4
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-4 unit

name: parcel_id_assessor
description: Raw parcel identifier as provided by the source

name: parcel_id_local
description: Standardized, locally cross-comparable parcel matching key

name: address_id_local
description: Standardized, town-scoped address matching key (no city component)

name: address_id_local_city
description: Standardized address matching key including city (only where city is available)

name: n_transactions
description: Number of recorded transactions on the parcel

name: type
description: Record or unit type or class

name: address_street_directional
description: Street directional prefix or suffix (N S E W)

name: address_street
description: Street name with type and directional

name: address_unit_type
description: Address unit type (Apt Suite Unit etc.)

name: owner_address_2
description: Owner mailing street address continuation line

name: owner_state
description: Owner mailing state or region (raw; use owner_admin2_id_admin1 when resolvable)

name: owner_admin2_id_admin1
description: Owner mailing state/region as the level-2 admin id coded within admin1 (in-country)

name: use_group_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_group

name: use_subgroup_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_subgroup

name: personal_property_value
description: Assessed value of taxable personal property

name: last_sale_price
description: Price of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_year
description: Year of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_month
description: Month of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_date
description: Date of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_qualification_code
description: Qualification code of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_vacant
description: Vacant or improved indicator at the most recent sale

name: last_sale_doc_type
description: Deed or instrument type of the most recent sale

name: last_sale_book_page
description: Registry book and page of the most recent sale

name: n_buildings
description: Number of buildings on the parcel

name: has_structure
description: Whether the parcel has a structure

name: geometry_source
description: Dataset the footprint geometry came from

name: priority_on_parcel
description: Footprint priority on its parcel (primary secondary or unknown)

name: slope
description: Average slope of a parcel or surface

name: coastal_water_share
description: Share of coastal waters within a radius

name: lake_distance
description: Distance to nearest lake larger than 4ha

name: wetland_share
description: Share of area covered by wetland polygons

name: public_land_acquisition_share
description: Share of area overlapping a public land acquisition

name: conservation_easement_share
description: Share of area under a conservation easement

name: protected_land_share
description: Share of area under fee/easement protection, given year and radius

name: soil_farmland_local_share
description: Share classified as locally-important farmland soil

name: soil_farmland_prime_share
description: Share classified as prime farmland soil

name: soil_farmland_statewide_share
description: Share classified as statewide-important farmland soil

name: building_footprint_share
description: Share of area within a radius covered by building footprints

name: footprint_area_m2
description: Total building footprint area on the parcel

name: n_footprints
description: Count of building footprints on the parcel

name: flood_depth_fluvial
description: Average fluvial flood inundation depth, given return period

name: flood_depth_pluvial
description: Average pluvial flood inundation depth, given return period

name: paved_road_distance
description: Minimum distance to nearest paved road

name: travel_time_to_city
description: Travel time to nearest major city

name: population_gravity_index
description: Population gravity: decay-weighted residential population density from a building-footprint-distributed population raster

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb
description: Predicted land value per hectare (natural log, real USD, deflated to a reference date); 'region-nb' model

name: aoa
description: Area of Applicability: rescaled dissimilarity to a model's training feature space (<=0 within domain, >0 extrapolation)
